as_told.title: Breeding program behind the psionic shootdown story

plain: Matthew Brown, a man presented on a podcast as a Pentagon whistleblower, tells host Jesse Michels about a secret practice of using people as bait to lure unknown craft so they can be shot down. Brown says this bait story is really a cover for using psychic people, which he calls psionics, as breeding stock, with the aim of producing a super psychic child generations later. At another point he puts it more simply, saying only that these people are brought in as breeding stock, which would mean a hidden human breeding programme if true.
